65|def parse_sections(text: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
66|    """Parse INI-style text into ``{section: {key: value}}``.
67|
68|    A line of the form ``[name]`` starts a new section. Keys that appear
69|    before any header are stored under the empty-string section ``""``.
70|    Each section body is handed to :func:`parse_kv`, so the same rules for
71|    comments, blank lines and duplicates apply within a section.
72|
73|    Raises:
74|        ValueError: if a section header is malformed or a body line has
75|            no ``=`` (propagated from :func:`parse_kv`).
76|    """
77|    sections: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
78|    current = ""
79|    buffer: list[str] = []
80|
81|    def flush() -> None:
82|        if current in sections:
83|            sections[current].update(parse_kv("\n".join(buffer)))
84|        else:
85|            sections[current] = parse_kv("\n".join(buffer))
86|        buffer.clear()
87|
88|    for raw in text.splitlines():
89|        line = raw.strip()
90|        if line.startswith("[") and not line.startswith("#"):
91|            match = _SECTION_RE.match(line)
92|            if match is None:
93|                raise ValueError(f"malformed section header: {raw!r}")
94|            flush()
95|            current = match.group("name").strip()
96|        else:
97|            buffer.append(raw)
98|    flush()
99|
100|    if not sections[""] and len(sections) > 1:
101|        del sections[""]
102|    return sections
103|

105|def coerce(value: str) -> Scalar:
106|    """Convert a raw string value into a Python scalar.
107|
108|    ``"true"``/``"false"`` (any case) become booleans, ``"null"``/``"none"``
109|    (any case) become ``None``, integer-looking strings become ``int`` and
110|    float-looking strings become ``float``. Anything else is returned
111|    unchanged as a string.
112|    """
113|    lowered = value.strip().lower()
114|    if lowered == "true":
115|        return True
116|    if lowered == "false":
117|        return False
118|    if lowered in ("null", "none"):
119|        return None
120|    if _INT_RE.match(lowered):
121|        return int(lowered)
122|    if _FLOAT_RE.match(lowered):
123|        return float(lowered)
124|    return value
125|
126|
127|def interpolate(
128|    values: dict[str, str], env: dict[str, str] | None = None
129|) -> dict[str, str]:
130|    """Expand ``${NAME}`` references inside every value.
131|
132|    A reference is resolved first against ``values`` itself and then against
133|    ``env``. Resolution is a single pass over each value, so a referenced
134|    value is substituted as-is, without being expanded in turn.
135|
136|    Raises:
137|        KeyError: if a referenced name is found in neither mapping.
138|    """
139|    env = env or {}
140|
141|    def lookup(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
142|        name = match.group("name")
143|        if name in values:
144|            return values[name]
145|        if name in env:
146|            return env[name]
147|        raise KeyError(name)
148|
149|    return {key: _REF_RE.sub(lookup, value) for key, value in values.items()}
150|
151|
152|def dumps(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
153|    """Serialise a dict as ``key=value`` lines, one per key, sorted by key.
154|
155|    The output round-trips through :func:`parse_kv` for any mapping whose
156|    keys contain no ``=`` and whose values have no leading or trailing
157|    whitespace.
158|    """
159|    return "\n".join(f"{key}={values[key]}" for key in sorted(values))
160|
161|
162|def load_file(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, str]:
163|    """Read ``path`` as UTF-8 text and parse it with :func:`parse_kv`."""
164|    return parse_kv(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

1|# demo_repo
2|
3|A small, dependency-free Python package for reading simple `key=value`
4|configuration files. `parser.py` provides `parse_kv` (the core line parser),
5|`parse_sections` (INI-style `[section]` headers), `coerce` (turn string
6|values into ints, floats, bools or `None`), `interpolate` (expand `${NAME}`
7|references), `dumps` (serialise a dict back to text) and `load_file` (parse
8|a file from disk).
9|
10|Run the tests from this directory:
11|
12|```
13|cd demo_repo && python -m pytest
14|```
15|
16|The suite includes one end-to-end test marked `slow` (see `pytest.ini`) that
17|takes several seconds; it is part of the normal run and should pass.
18|
19|Owner: Rahul (P2).

To go green, that test needs updating to the new contract. That call belongs to the test owner, so I am flagging it rather than weakening the test myself.
